references.text: Moses' command that verse 5 refers to - he called on Mishael and Elzaphan to carry the bodies away from the sanctuary
The description of the priests' tunics (כֻּתֳּנֹת) that Nadab and Abihu were still wearing when they were carried out
Unclean persons were to be led outside the camp, following the same principle of removing impurity from the center of the camp
The red heifer was to be led outside the camp - a parallel to how the bodies were carried outside the camp
The blasphemer was to be led outside the camp - using the same expression 'outside the camp' (מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה)
Jesus suffered outside the city gate - a typological parallel to what was carried 'outside the camp'
